mode: Stock InnoDB storage, utf8mb4, empty sql_mode, foreign_key_checks=1, native markers, 16 KiB pages.

Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyI.role: Exact shared native integer comparison for both ordered sides of a reference.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyI.structure: One native integer storage width and an unsigned flag.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyI.conditions: The two original fields have equal native storage width and signedness.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyI.meaning: Compare integer values in the external source domain and contribute the native integer width to the physical key.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyI.sql: The ordered column references carry this domain without a type annotation in SQL.

Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.role: The native string comparison between the ordered child and parent fields.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.structure: Two closed typed native storage values, independently sized.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.conditions: Both sides use the same explicit native character collation or both are binary string storage.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.meaning: Use exact native collation, padding and byte equality of the declared storage. Keep both layouts for checked field roles.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.sql: The emitted foreign-key lists name the corresponding external fields that carry these types.

Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.role: One physical byte or character value participating in a resolved reference.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.structure: A closed storage kind, declared length, and utf8mb4 collation when applicable.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.conditions: A nonzero field length fits its chosen family. Only character values require a collation. The parent group checks full index capacity.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.meaning: Supply exact comparable storage, bytes or characters, declared size and fixed-width behavior.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.sql: Supply the native type facts of an external column. A reference emits its checked qualified column coordinate.

Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.structure: Closed fixed and varying character and byte-string families.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.conditions: The selected kind determines fixed-width and length units. A character family requires a checked collation.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.meaning: Distinguish the native per-field width, character behavior and fixed-width storage effects.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyS.sql: The external declaration fixes this type. Emit its referenced physical field name.

Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyT.role: A fixed native utf8mb4 comparison collation.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyT.structure: Closed utf8mb4_bin, utf8mb4_general_ci and utf8mb4_unicode_ci cases.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyT.conditions: Both text roles must have the same resolved collation. The native release and column types establish the external interpretation.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyT.meaning: Compare native text values and preserve their exact stored bytes in observed results.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/Domain/ForeignKeyT.sql: The reference preserves both native typed fields and their resolved external comparison.

Schema/ForeignKey/Add/ForeignKeyPair.role: One ordered pair of resolved native string or integer fields.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/ForeignKeyPair.structure: Child and referenced physical names and a closed comparison domain, with child nullability and physical key direction.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/ForeignKeyPair.conditions: Column names satisfy their ordinary native field role. The selected domain fixes compatible native value types for both columns.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/ForeignKeyPair.meaning: Compare the two external values according to the exact selected domain. Compute full native key width in bytes.
Schema/ForeignKey/Add/ForeignKeyPair.sql: The enclosing addition emits the checked ordered child and parent field names and the selected child direction.

negative: Mixed binary and character roles, different collation, zero width, unknown collation and open catalog
Per-field and total native key boundaries under compact and dynamic storage
observations: Absolute parent/child identities, exact native data types and per-field selected collation
Original and resulting field and total physical key sizes and observed row formats
Declared primary/secondary index shape, true foreign constraints and event effects
Exact stored values, whitespace, byte padding, native text equality and reference rejections
Independent parent update and delete probes record physical CHAR padding, exact propagated bytes and native child-width refusals.

evidence.P01: Retain the exact physical string types, lengths, collation or byte policy, and ordered reference sides.
evidence.P02: Validate exact comparison compatibility, fixed capacities, original external key support and physical namespace before publication.
evidence.P03: Keep only typed immutable comparison and physical coordinates. The originating schema and storage declaration facts remain transient.
evidence.P04: Compute the individual full term capacity and combined physical key bound, and compose ordered field compatibility.
evidence.P05: Verify sealed string and integer roles and actual source/installed constructor certificates.
evidence.P06: Observe original and emitted SQL, exact stored bytes and NULL, native constraint metadata, physical key and diagnostic effects.

obligations.Q01: Validate closed comparison values and observed exact boundary refusals.
obligations.Q02: Reconcile every fixed character/byte coordinate across both construction paths and exact native admissions.
obligations.Q03: Check ordered multi-field terms, exact typed compatibility and separate field width and total key capacity.
obligations.Q04: Verify native row comparison and preserved stored bytes plus dictionary metadata, effects, diagnostics and unsupported probe controls.
obligations.Q05: Link pinned executable, explicit PHP storage rules, installed constructor trace and native rerun ledgers.

faults: Erase the declared string update cascade.
Erase the declared string delete-null effect.
Erase retained zero bytes after a successful native text comparison.
Treat a binary-collated case difference as equal.
trackedBeyondThisSlice: Storage with nondefault page sizes, nonstock legacy global mode, compression block size, other text collations and default charset inference.
Decimal, floating, temporal, enumeration and generated field types and other SQL family proof obligations.
trust: Correctly interpreted same external schema and native profile.
Fixed finite output bytes and native equality witnesses, PHP diagnostics, installed distribution and actual release engine.
